name: Grand Khavatari
notes: The line uses fists only: every attack and totem needs DUALFIST.

Charges: Focused Force 50 adds one charge per cast (20 HP, 5 MP); Raging Force 346 (78) fills 8 charges at once. Used: Force Blaster 54 1, Force Burst 17 1, Force Storm 35 1, Hurricane Assault 284 2, Break Duress 461 2-3, Force Meditation 441 3, Force Barrier 443 4 (when.charges on each row).
The bot should top up charges between pulls (Focused Force out of combat) so they are full at the start of each pull [DP].
The 76-85 table lists only the changes ("Same as Tyrant"): the Tyrant rows it does not replace are kept below (why: "kept from the 40-75 Tyrant table").

rows.trig: Titan line: Every time it's off cooldown (3 s) against the current target. Sword/blunt.
Titan line: AoE: none in this band.
rows.why: the guide lists no AoE skill for this band

rows.trig: Titan line: Never: none.
rows.why: the guide lists no never-skill for this band

rows.trig: Ranged: Force Blaster (24, 1 charge, 600 range): pull a mob from range, or finish a fleeing mob.
Force Blaster: listed with the single-target skills (1 charge).
Charge refill: Raging Force (8 charges, 600 range, 50 HP) whenever charges < 2 in combat.
Rotation: same as Tyrant — Hurricane Assault (charges >= 2).
Rotation: same as Tyrant — then Burning Fist.
Rotation: same as Tyrant — then Soul Breaker.
Fortitude on against stunners.
Riposte Stance (reflects 30 % but Atk.Spd x0.8): off for PvE DPS.
rows.why: off for PvE DPS

rows.trig: Emergency: Force Barrier (10 s invincible, 4 charges, 15 min reuse) when HP < 20 % with no heal coming.
Never: Force Meditation (stuns self, P.Def x0.2).
Never: Symbol of Energy (manual).
rows.why: manual: item 8875 + 30-min reuse

when.text: the mobs are in front of me

rows.trig: Use >= 3 mobs as the threshold, since AoE power is low (533) and each use costs a charge. Force Burst (43+, FAN 180 deg r200, 1 charge, 3 s) for mobs in front of you.
rows.why: kept from the 40-75 Tyrant table (the 76-85 table lists only changes)

rows.trig: >= 3 mobs. Force Storm (49+, AoE r150 around the target, 500 cast range, 1 charge, 5 s) on a clumped group at range (it pulls them all).
rows.why: kept from the 40-75 Tyrant table (the 76-85 table lists only changes)

rows.trig: Big hit: Punch of Doom (55+, about 9132 power, costs about 400-500 HP, 5 min reuse). Raid or champion mobs only, never trash.
rows.why: kept from the 40-75 Tyrant table (the 76-85 table lists only changes)

rows.trig: Fury Fists (43: Atk.Spd x1.25, drains 12 HP per tick) on in combat while HP > 50 %.
rows.why: kept from the 40-75 Tyrant table (the 76-85 table lists only changes)

rows.trig: Or Fury Fists as an HP-drain tool before Zealot or Bison (the GK low-HP combo is Zealot plus Bison with Fury Fists on).

rows.trig: War Frenzy (58+) always on.
